summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.2B in SPX 4000C (Dec 2026) and $928M in SPX 7000C (Sept 2026) single-day accumulations. While NDX and META show extreme intraday call dominance (P/C 0.14 and 0.19 respectively), the massive multi-day persistence in SPX 7000C (over $3.6B across 4 sessions) and SPX 4000C (over $2.4B) signals a high-conviction, long-dated "LEAPS" strategy targeting significant index expansion. Traders should watch for continued volatility in the SPX 7000-8000 strike range, as the heavy accumulation of both 7000C and 8000P suggests institutions are building a massive, long-term volatility/directional spread.
